pages.text: [#](53341a)A spirit bound to a physical object becomes something useful — the scarecrow that watches with intent, the effigy that senses intrusion, the ladder that extends a boundary.[#]()
pages.title: Fetishes

pages.text: [#](53341a)To make a fetish, place the host object in a medium circle with an Attuned Stone, a Necromantic Stone, and a Boline, then sacrifice the required spirits near the circle. The rite binds them to the vessel.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Voodoo Protection** makes Voodoo Protection Poppets endure more hostile poppet pressure nearby. **Sentinel** sends spectres against uninvited guests. **Shrieking** emits a redstone pulse and a banshee's cry.[#]()
pages.title: What a Fetish Does

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Disorientation** turns armed or armored trespassers around and leaves them sickened. **Ghost Walking** spares those walking the spirit world nearby from being hurried back.[#]()
[#](53341a)Use a Boline to cycle the trigger mode, and a Taglock Kit to say who counts as an intruder.[#]()
